3-WEEK STRENGTH & CONDITIONING PLAN — BOXER (KG LOADS)
Start: Wed 18 Nov 2026
WEEKLY STRUCTURE
Mon – Lower strength + core
Tue – Boxing + roadwork
Wed – Upper strength + shoulders
Thu – Boxing + easy run
Fri – Power/explosive
Sat – Sparring + conditioning
Sun – Recovery/mobility
WEEK 1 — ACCUMULATION
Wed 18 – Upper Strength
Warm-up 10 min: band pull-aparts 2x15, scap push-ups 2x10, skip rope 3 min
☐ Push-ups 4x8-10 (add 10kg plate if able)
☐ DB rows 4x8-10 each @ 24-28kg
☐ Strict press 3x6-8 @ 40-45kg
☐ Face pulls 3x15 @ 15-20kg
☐ Chin-ups 3x6-10 (add 5kg if able)
☐ Band external rotations 3x12 each
☐ Plank 3x45s
☐ Side plank 2x30s each
Stretch 5 min
Thu 19 – Roadwork + Boxing
☐ Easy run 30-40 min (conversational)
☐ Boxing session – technical, moderate
☐ Shadowbox 3x3 min, 1 min rest
Fri 20 – Power
Warm-up 10 min + med ball slams 2x8 @ 8kg
☐ Deadlift 5x3 @ 100-110kg – fast bar speed
☐ Med ball rotational throws 3x5 each @ 6-8kg
☐ Box jumps 3x5 (soft landings)
☐ DB push press 3x5 @ 20-24kg each
☐ Woodchops 3x10 each @ 20-25kg
☐ Sled push 5x20m @ 40-60kg / hill sprints 5x20m
☐ Hanging knee raises 3x10
Sat 21 – Sparring + Conditioning
☐ Sparring/technical rounds as scheduled
☐ Finisher: 6x30s bag / 30s rest
☐ 10 min walk + stretch
Sun 22 – Recovery
☐ Easy walk/cycle 30-40 min
☐ Mobility 15 min – hips, T-spine, shoulders
☐ Foam roll
Mon 23 – Lower Strength
Warm-up: leg swings, BW squats 2x15, glute bridges 2x15
☐ Back squat 4x6-8 @ 80-90kg
☐ RDL 3x8 @ 70-80kg
☐ Split squats 3x8 each @ 20-24kg DBs
☐ Calf raises 3x15 @ 40kg
☐ Pallof press 3x12 each @ 15-20kg
☐ Dead bug 3x10 each
Tue 24 – Roadwork + Boxing
☐ Easy run 35-45 min (or 20 min tempo)
☐ Skill session – footwork + combos
☐ Skip rope 4x2 min, 30s rest
WEEK 2 — INTENSIFICATION
Wed 25 – Upper Strength
☐ Push-ups 4x10-12 (add 15kg plate)
☐ DB rows 4x10 each @ 26-30kg
☐ Strict press 3x7-8 @ 42-47kg
☐ Face pulls 3x15 @ 20kg

☐ Hill sprints 6x20m

☐ Finisher: 8x30s bag / 30s rest

Sun 29 – Recovery
☐ Easy walk/cycle 30-40 min

WEEK 3 — PEAK / DELOAD-READY
Wed 2 – Upper Strength
☐ Push-ups 4x8-10 (add 15-20kg plate)
☐ DB rows 4x8 each @ 30-34kg
☐ Strict press 3x5-6 @ 45-50kg
☐ Face pulls 3x15 @ 20kg

☐ Plank 3x45s

☐ Easy run 30 min

KEY NOTES
· Loads are starting points — adjust to your 1RM (strength work at ~70-80% 1RM, RPE 7-8)
· Power days: bar speed is the goal, not grinding reps
· Boxing quality first — cut accessory volume if fatigued
· Shoulder work every upper day — non-negotiable
· Keep runs easy (Zone 2); one hard touch per week max
· Sleep 7-9 hrs; protein 1.6-2g/kg bodyweight
· Fight scheduled? Cut Fri power + Sat conditioning 3-4 days out
· Week 3 is lighter by design — absorb the work before next block
